prompts:
Use case: logo-brand.
Create one polished identity exploration board for the name "flan36", a minimal low-profile 36-key wireless split keyboard whose owner loves Mexican flan dessert.
Direction 01, CARAMEL: a supremely simple, elegant geometric flan pudding icon: gently tapered body, soft rounded corners, a thin caramel top with one intentional drape, subtle negative-space reference to a keycap. Flat, vector-friendly, confident silhouette, original design, no mascot face. Custom lowercase rounded geometric wordmark exactly "flan36", modest tracking, the numeral 36 at equal baseline.
Board format square, warm ivory background. Top tiny label "01 / CARAMEL". Upper half large caramel-and-custard color lockup. Lower half three clean separated samples: black-on-white icon, white-on-dark PCB silkscreen concept with the exact same icon and wordmark, and an embossed mark on a dark teal 3D-printed plastic case surface. Mark fidelity across all three. This is a branding presentation, not a keyboard design or engineering drawing.
Use bold simple geometry that survives tiny monochrome printing and shallow embossing. No gradients inside the logo, no fine hatching, no circuitry clutter, no fake measurements. Restrained colors honey caramel, warm custard, deep teal. Lots of whitespace. Exact text only: "01 / CARAMEL", "flan36", "MONO", "PCB", "CASE".

Use case: logo-brand.
Create one polished identity exploration board for "flan36", a minimal low-profile 36-key wireless split keyboard connected to Mexican flan dessert.
Direction 02, SPLIT: an original iconic flan silhouette divided cleanly down the middle into two balanced halves, with a narrow negative-space split evoking the two halves of an ergonomic keyboard. Rounded geometric, no face, no extraneous ornament; caramel caps on both halves, each half slightly separated while the whole silhouette is recognizably flan. Distinct custom lowercase "flan36" wordmark, understated contemporary geometric type.
Square board, warm ivory background. Tiny top label "02 / SPLIT". Upper half large two-color icon and wordmark. Lower half three separated exact same logo samples: a bold black single-ink icon on ivory, white silkscreen concept on a dark teal PCB surface, and debossed into a muted terracotta 3D-printed plastic case surface. No depiction of whole keyboard, no extra electronics. Main identity must remain legible without color and have no fragile small details.
Exact text only: "02 / SPLIT", "flan36", "MONO", "PCB", "CASE". Flat vector-friendly primary artwork, generous whitespace, elegant small brand studio layout. No gradients in the mark, no hatching, no fake technical dimensions.

Use case: logo-brand.
Create one original identity exploration board for "flan36", a minimal low-profile 36-key wireless split keyboard with playful Mexican flan and retro handheld inspiration.
Direction 03, PIXEL: compact 8-bit pixel-art flan pudding emblem, caramel top and warm custard tapered body, designed on a clean coarse square grid. No face. A tiny intentional geometric step/split references a keyboard key. Strong simple outline that becomes a clear one-ink shape. Custom "flan36" lowercase pixel wordmark, legible and compact. Avoid existing game characters or existing brand marks.
Square board, light warm ivory background. Tiny top label "03 / PIXEL". Upper half large clean color emblem and wordmark. Lower half three separated samples of exactly the same mark: black one-ink icon, ivory silkscreen on a deep burgundy PCB surface, and a two-color inset mark on a light gray 3D-printed plastic case surface. Mark shape must be identical across the applications, no fake hardware dimensions or whole-keyboard rendering.
Exact text only: "03 / PIXEL", "flan36", "MONO", "PCB", "CASE". Restrained custard/caramel palette with dark burgundy. Crisp flat pixels, no gradients or rounded anti-pixel corners inside artwork. Airy premium editorial layout, charming but minimal.
